description: Java entity class representing product pricing details in an e-commerce system, including price amount, type, special dates, and associations with product availability and descriptions.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: Entity class for product pricing, including fields for price amount, type, special dates, and relationships with availability and descriptions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product price.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product price.

methods.name: getProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the main price amount.

methods.name: setProductPriceAmount
methods.description: Sets the main price amount.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the special start date for the price.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the special start date for the price.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Returns a clone of the special end date for the price.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the special end date for the price.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Retrieves the special price amount.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialAmount
methods.description: Sets the special price amount.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with this price.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this price.

methods.name: isDefaultPrice
methods.description: Checks if this is the default price.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets whether this is the default price.

methods.name: setProductAvailability
methods.description: Associates a product availability entity.

methods.name: getProductAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves the associated product availability.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the price code.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Retrieves the price code.

methods.name: setProductPriceType
methods.description: Sets the type of the product price.

methods.name: getProductPriceType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the product price.
